paragraphs.text: Thalakos is a creature type used for a species of insane Spirit -like beings trapped in the Shadows of Rath .
Thalakos have only been printed in blue .

The cards as they appeared in the Tempest block didn't have the subtype Thalakos. It was later realized that a non- human species should have its own subtype, which was fixed in the Grand Creature Type Update .

Thalakos is the only creature type in the game (outside of token-exclusive types) that has never been printed in the type line on paper . The type was featured in Tempest Remastered , but that was a digital-only set.
The Thalakos originally lived on Dominaria , possibly with a different appearance.

During their planeshift , the Thalakos were caught in the conflict between the Dauthi and the Soltari , despite their neutrality. All three races were caught in the maelstrom of energy that surrounded Rath , and trapped within the "Shadows," the extraplanar space between Rath and Dominaria. They were left in an incorporeal state, unable to communicate with people on either plane, yet able to see into both the Dominarian reality and that of Rath. This predicament led the Thalakos to lose their sanity.

Most Thalakos have the keyword ability Shadow representing their incorporeal state while trapped between the realities of Dominaria and Rath. The one exception is Thalakos Drifters , which doesn't have Shadow, but has an activated ability that grants itself Shadow.
